faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate - II position is 02 August 2026. Ensure you apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MSc in Geology or Applied Geology and have a minimum of 2 years of research experience. Additionally, a NET/GATE qualification is required for Post MSc candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate - II post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate - II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate - II position at CSIR - National Institute of Oceanography.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - II recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Associate - II is a contractual job. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Where is CSIR NIO located?
faq.answer: CSIR - National Institute of Oceanography (CSIR NIO) is located in Goa.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is FBR00405/3286-28.

faq.question: Q10. Does the notification mention any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age limits or age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for this information.
